entities.summary: Johan Motin is a Swedish professional ice hockey defenceman. He is currently playing with HIFK of the Finnish Liiga. Motin was selected by the Edmonton Oilers in the 4th round of the 2008 NHL Entry Draft, and played one game with them during the 2009–10 season.
